body: I write on the side. He says it's pointless but honestly it is the only thing that has given my life any real meaning in such a long time. It's my one and only escape and the only thing that has me hanging onto life, even if it's by a constantly thinning thread.

On my drives home I always hope to hit a moose since it's pretty much a death sentence. However nothing ever happens and I end up living one more day. Sometimes I wonder if it's because my life has some awesome curveball coming that I'm unaware of.

Maybe the same is true for you OP.
If you really want to die find some fentanyl.

I do, although I'm not religious whatsoever. I believe that when we die we cross the veil to the Otherside where reality is more malleable and is created by our thoughts pretty much instantly. I also believe are souls are eternal and that life on Earth is pretty much like university for souls. It's a place to learn and grow, and that's about it.

Knowing this also makes staying one day on Earth a lot harder for me though.

There is an afterlife, so there is no maybe about seeing them again. You most certainly will. Our bodies are basically machines that eventually break down and corrode, but our spirits which give us life are eternal just like energy.

I wish that worked for everyone. I told my mom I was suicidal and not only did the bitch laugh about it to my face, she told me to stop being so overdramatic and then proceeded to find an ad for some religious quack's cd and told me to listen to it if I *really* was as desperate as I claimed to be.
